scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @party/api" "npm run dev -w @party/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @party/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @party/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @party/api && npm run build -w @party/web
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @party/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:demo -w @party/api --
